label: subsidiary or organizational unit of
definition: Organization X is a subsidiary, division or organizational unit of Y.
scope_notes: Explicit unit, subsidiary, division, parent or owned-by qualify, including historical ownership. Mere affiliation, employee roles, geographic places and reverse ownership do not. City-as-office metonymy requires review.

facts.reason: Euro RSCG Worldwide is explicitly a unit, division and owned part of Havas Advertising.
John Huang is a Commerce Department official or operative working there; a person employed by a department is not its subsidiary or organizational unit.
Fox is directly described as owned by and part of News Corporation.
Eastern is explicitly a subsidiary and unit of Texas Air Corporation, with parent and acquisition evidence.
NBC is repeatedly a unit, subsidiary and owned part of General Electric Company.
